_: The first ten minutes (--opening=v2; docs/review/first-ten-minutes-plan.md). Tune here, not in code. quietToWinter: no threat, no ultimatum until the first winter has passed (bridge opening.js). firstSetbackSeasons: the first ruling that slights the lord who asked comes back this many seasons later, as a plea for amends (about 5:00 in, from a first ruling at ~1:00 on a 40 s season). calmShare: in every timed reign (v2 or not), the first share of the clock is the King's to learn the court: no threat rises and no house sends an ultimatum (0.2 = the first three minutes of fifteen; gameplay review #1). usurperFromAct: no pretender whispers of a better claim before this act (1 = the first quarter, 2 = from the second). quietSeasons: every reign's first seasons (4, a year) are quiet the same way: no rising, no pretender, no ultimatum (counted only while the King watches, so never under the loading card).

calm._: The calm opening (opening.js may/began; Mac 2026-11-16: 'too chaotic ... not very clear what I should be doing'; Frostpunk's and Anno's onboarding: one system at a time). For the reign's first seasons (counted while the King watches) at most one trouble that asks something of the King is live at a time, and its kinds come in order: a kind may start once every kind before it in order has started, or once its turn has waited waitSeasons. A trouble stays live until its owner says it is over (the raid beaten or gone, the court risen, the card answered, the sickness gone, the threat ended, the envoy answered) or for at most liveSeasons; one with no state of its own (a border raid, a story) for leaseSeasons. restSeasons: quiet seasons after one ends before the next may start. stories: stories running at once in the opening (stories.json maxActive after). decks: the kind of each event card's deck; threats: the kind of each of the director's threats.
